investigation-plan.title: API Periods Endpoint 500 Error Analysis and Resolution Plan

problem-summary.description: The /api/periods/ endpoint returns "Request failed with status code 500" when accessed after admin authorization. The frontend call to http://localhost:5173/api/periods/ fails with 500 error.
problem-summary.impact: - Users cannot access periods management in settings - Complete breakdown of settings/periods functionality - Potential authentication/session issues affecting other endpoints

current-findings.database-status: HEALTHY - PostgreSQL connection working, periods table contains data (5 records with user_ids 3,5,6)
current-findings.backend-health: HEALTHY - FastAPI backend responding to /health endpoint
current-findings.frontend-proxy: PARTIALLY WORKING - Proxy redirects to backend but authentication fails
current-findings.session-storage: ISSUE DETECTED - Redis contains sessions but user data is empty: {"user": {}}
current-findings.authentication: FAILING - "Not authenticated" response indicates session/auth middleware issues

step.title: Capture Real-time Backend Logs
step.description: Monitor backend logs during a periods API call to identify the exact 500 error source
step.expected-outcome: Identify exact error stack trace causing 500 response

step.title: Validate Session Middleware Chain
step.description: Test if SessionMiddleware is properly attached and processing requests

tests.test: Verify SessionMiddleware is added to FastAPI app
Check Redis connection initialization in middleware

step.title: Debug Authentication Dependency Chain
step.description: Trace the get_current_user dependency execution path

debug-points.point: Validate session data structure and user_id extraction
Check for logging output during auth process

step.title: Analyze Session Data Structure
step.description: Investigate why Redis sessions have empty user data

investigation.check: Examine multiple session keys in Redis
Compare session format with expected express-session structure
Validate session creation during login process
Check session expiration and cleanup logic

step.title: Test Database Model Compatibility
step.description: Ensure Period model aligns with database schema and SQLAlchemy 2.0 async patterns

step.title: Frontend Proxy Configuration Review
step.description: Verify Vite proxy configuration for API routing

actions.action: Execute investigation steps 1-3 to identify exact failure point
Determine if issue is in authentication, session management, or database layer
Document specific error messages and stack traces

fixes.fix: Update Period model for SQLAlchemy 2.0 compatibility
Fix async session handling in endpoints

scenario.name: Response Format Issue
scenario.symptoms: Pydantic validation errors, response serialization failures

tests.test: Test periods endpoint directly via backend (port 4000)
Test periods endpoint via frontend proxy (port 5173)
Verify proper user session handling and data isolation
Test all CRUD operations (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
Validate error responses for edge cases

success-criteria.criterion: GET /api/periods/ returns 200 with valid period data
Authentication properly identifies user and filters by user_id

actions.action: Add enhanced error logging for session debugging
Create automated test for periods endpoint authentication flow
Document fix in architecture decisions (ADR format)
Update monitoring alerts for similar issues

high-risk.item: Session management changes could affect all authenticated endpoints
Database model changes could break other CRUD operations

mitigation.item: Test all settings endpoints after any session fixes
Backup current working state before major changes
Use Docker container isolation for safe testing

debugging.command: docker exec budget-backend python -c "import logging; logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG)"

testing.command: docker exec budget-backend python -m pytest tests/backend/test_periods_api.py -v
docker exec budget-frontend npm run test periods.test.ts

immediate.outcome: /api/periods/ endpoint returns 200 status with valid data
Frontend settings/periods page loads without errors
Authentication correctly identifies and filters user data

long-term.outcome: Improved error handling and debugging capabilities
Enhanced monitoring for similar authentication issues
